meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先识别文件扩展名，对明确支持的科学数据文件（如 CSV/TSV/JSON、NumPy、HDF5、FASTA/FASTQ、基础图像元数据）做探索性分析，生成 Markdown 报告，包含结构、统计摘要、质量问题、预处理与下游分析建议；不认识的格式会拒绝或仅参考。
howto.when: 当用户给出科学数据文件路径，或要求“分析/查看/总结”某个文件时触发；主要用于 CSV/TSV/JSON、NumPy、HDF5、FASTA/FASTQ 等格式。

say.text: 分析一下这个 reads.fastq 文件。
say.note: Claude 会检测类型并生成 EDA 报告。

say.text: 看看 experiment_results.csv 的缺失值和统计摘要。
say.note: 会输出表格结构和质量指标。

say.text: 检查 data.npy 的维度、数据类型和异常值。
say.note: 会分析数组并给出预处理建议。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects the file extension and analyzes supported scientific files (CSV/TSV/JSON, NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, basic image metadata), generating a Markdown report on structure, stats, quality, and preprocessing/downstream steps. Unknown formats fail closed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a path to a scientific data file or asks to 'analyze/view/summarize' a file, mainly for supported formats like CSV/TSV/JSON, NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ.

say_en.note: Claude will detect the type and generate an EDA report.

say_en.text: Check missing values and stats in experiment_results.csv.
say_en.note: Outputs table structure and quality metrics.

say_en.text: Inspect dimensions, dtypes, and outliers in data.npy.
say_en.note: Analyzes the array and gives preprocessing advice.
